Name: Event Lookup
Author: shekurika
Description:
[b][size=4][b]Works for Custom NPCs
[/b][/size] (yes, that means with Stardew Valley Expanded and Ridgeside Village, too)

NEW: [/b]Controller support and translation support. Currently available in english, german,turkish, portuguese and chinese . If you want to translate the mod, feel free to contact me. :)



By pressing [b]N[/b] (configurable), you can access a list of all heart events that you can trigger today, with some information when/how to trigger them.

And this mod allows you to look up heart events of all characters in the game.

[b]Supported Languages: [/b]English, German, Turkish (by Kedi), Chinese (by 筱星若), portuguese (by Thayronhamann)

[b]Recommendations for improvements are very welcome.[/b] Just post them here :)

For Modauthors:
Valid patch targets are [code]﻿Mods/shekurika.EventLookup/blocklist
Mods/shekurika.EventLookup/locationnames
Mods/shekurika.EventLookup/button
Mods/shekurika.EventLookup/statusCover
[/code]You can CP patch event IDs into blocklist so they won't show up in the available events list.
You can CP patch location names so your locations have whatever name you want them to have :)

Check the example file and if you need help, feel free to contact me!

Known Issues: No known issues currently

This mod is still in beta. Please report all bugs/suggestions here on nexusmods or on the official SDV discord to shekurika#8884.
